text: If cruise enable switch is off, state shall be OFF from any state.
If enable switch turns on while OFF, state shall become STANDBY.
In STANDBY, a SET rising edge with speed >= 30 km/h and brake and clutch released shall activate cruise and latch set speed = current speed (rounded).
In STANDBY, a SET rising edge with speed < 30 km/h shall be ignored.
In ACTIVE, brake or clutch applied shall move state to SUSPENDED and retain set speed.
In SUSPENDED, a RESUME rising edge with speed >= 30 km/h and brake and clutch released shall return to ACTIVE with retained set speed.
In ACTIVE or SUSPENDED, vehicle speed < 30 km/h shall move state to STANDBY and clear set speed.
A SET request with speed > 105 km/h shall be ignored (max set speed 105 km/h).
Set speed output shall be 0 whenever state is OFF or STANDBY.
Cruise-active output (J1939 SPN 595) shall be 1 only in ACTIVE.
